title: Tech Note: Component for Managing Server Files from 4D Remote (R2) - Revised 2/24/2022
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core technique — using the Execute on Server method property to run file operations on the server and a component to package the UI — remains a valid and still-used 4D pattern for remote file management; this is a modernization of a 2015 tech note (15-07) rather than a fundamentally new approach.
related_updates: The underlying Execute on Server attribute and component packaging model are unchanged in current 4D versions

The collection-based Listbox and Folder/File object-based file system classes used for the 2021 rewrite reflect the ORDA-era, object/collection-first style that continues to be 4D's recommended approach over legacy arrays
